title: TranscribeIt progress event contract v1
description: FROZEN CONTRACT. Emitted by Track A (engine) as JSON Lines - exactly one compact JSON object per line, UTF-8, newline-terminated, flushed immediately. Consumed by Track E (WPF taskbar UI) which tails the stream. The UI must ignore unrecognised 'type' values and unrecognised fields rather than failing, so the engine can add events later without breaking it.

stage.description: Pipeline stage. Weights used to compute overallPercent are fixed in stageWeights below.

stageWeights._comment: NOT part of an event. Reference values the engine uses so the taskbar bar advances smoothly and never stalls. Must sum to 100.

stagePercent.description: Progress within the current stage. Null when the stage cannot report granular progress - the UI should then show an indeterminate/marquee taskbar state.

overallPercent.description: Authoritative value for TaskbarItemInfo.ProgressValue (divide by 100). Monotonically non-decreasing - the UI may assume it never goes backwards.

etaSeconds.description: Smoothed estimate of seconds remaining for the CURRENT ITEM. Null means not yet estimable; the UI must then show 'estimating...' rather than '0 min left'.

message.description: Short human-readable status for the window body, e.g. 'Transcribing audio'.

itemTotal.description: Batch size. When >1 the UI shows 'File 2 of 5'.

itemName.description: Leaf filename of the item being processed.

pdfPath.description: Absolute path to the produced PDF, in the same folder as the source. The UI wires 'Open PDF' and 'Open folder' to this.

turnsPath.description: Absolute path to the intermediate turns JSON, if retained for debugging.

warnings.description: The UI SHOULD show a subtle notice when non-empty.

message.description: User-facing, plain language. No stack traces - those go to logPath.

logPath.description: Absolute path to the run log. The UI surfaces this as a clickable link.

fatal.description: False means the batch continues with the next item; the UI keeps running rather than switching to the terminal error state.

oneOf.title: batchComplete
oneOf.description: Terminal event. The UI clears TaskbarItemInfo.ProgressState, sets the overlay badge, and calls FlashWindowEx exactly once on receiving this.
